::: {.lead-intro}
This page is continuously updated with the lecture slides and  other practice materials for Research Methods & Statistics. Use the toggle in the sidebar to switch between light and dark mode.
:::

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

# The page monitors this year's slide folder; drop new PDFs into it and they
# appear on the next render. Bump this one line each academic year.
year_dir  <- "2026"
slide_dir <- file.path("slides", year_dir)
base_url  <- sprintf("https://johnnydoorn.github.io/teaching-statistics/rms/slides/%s", year_dir)

# CamelCase / underscore file stems -> readable titles
beautify <- function(stem) {
  s <- gsub("_", " ", stem)
  s <- gsub("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", "\\1 \\2", s)  # split camelCase
  s <- gsub("\\s*&\\s*", " & ", s)              # tidy ampersands
  s <- gsub("\\s+", " ", s)
  trimws(s)
}

url_for <- function(files, sub = "") {
  enc <- vapply(files, utils::URLencode, character(1), reserved = TRUE)
  sprintf("%s%s/%s", base_url, sub, enc)
}
pill <- function(url, label = "slides") {
  sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" class="external">%s</a>', url, label)
}
```

## Slides

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
pdfs <- list.files(slide_dir, pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = FALSE)

if (length(pdfs) == 0) {
  knitr::asis_output('<p class="text-muted fst-italic">Slides will appear here as the semester progresses.</p>')
} else {
  m     <- str_match(pdfs, "^RMS\\d+_(\\d+)_(.+)\\.pdf$")
  num   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m[, 2]))
  title <- ifelse(is.na(m[, 3]), beautify(sub("\\.pdf$", "", pdfs)), beautify(m[, 3]))
  ord   <- order(ifelse(is.na(num), Inf, num), title)

  df <- data.frame(
    `#`       = ifelse(is.na(num[ord]), "", as.character(num[ord])),
    Lecture   = title[ord],
    Slides    = pill(url_for(pdfs[ord])),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  knitr::kable(df, escape = FALSE, format = "html", row.names = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = TRUE)
}
```
